description: Smart motor protection and starter relay with Modbus RTU module: communication settings, remote commands, digital I/O and programmable reads
source: WEG SRW 01 Modbus RTU communication manual 10000013033 version 6.0x (Portuguese)
notes: Needs the Modbus-RTU communication kit (RS485, connector XC2 or DB9 XC15). Check P084 = 1 to see that the module is recognized.
Set the address (P725, 1 to 247, factory 63) and speed (P726, factory 38400 bit/s). The default byte format is 8 data bits, no parity, 2 stop bits (P310 = 3). Functions 01, 02, 03, 05, 06, 15 and 16.

Parameters P000 to P799 are the holding registers 0 to 799, user parameters P800 to P899 are 800 to 899. Only the parameters the Modbus manual describes are listed. The monitoring and motor parameters are in the SRW 01 user manual, which is not covered here.

The manual also lists word markers MW8200 to MW8849, float markers MF9000 to MF9174 (two registers each, IEEE-754), macro parameters PM3700 to PM3731 and bit markers MX6100 to MX7507 (coils 6100 to 7507) used by Ladder programs. These depend on the user program and are not listed.
Values are integers without decimal point.
Written from the manufacturer's manual; not tested on a device.

byte_format.2: 8 data bits, odd parity, 1 stop bit
